answer: Transitive trust graph routing mitigates Sybil attacks by bounding reputation flow from verified seeds across endorsement edges. Across a porous karst topology, nodes audit interactions via whisper gossip to balance peer capacity. This confines unvetted clusters to a narrow reputation ledge, forcing an adversary to incur the verifiable cost of securing genuine social capital per identity. However, this mechanism penalizes honest newcomers through severe cold-start latency.
